text: lynkr-dsh-plugin 是 DSH 模型提供方插件，加载时将本地 Lynkr 网关配置加入 settings.yaml。它设置 OpenAI 兼容接口地址和 lynkr-auto 模型标识；已有 lynkr 配置时保持不变，解析或写入失败会提示手动设置。适合希望通过本机 Lynkr 网关连接模型的用户。配置使用 LYNKR_API_KEY 环境变量名，网关默认地址为 http://127.0.0.1:8081/v1。

lynkr-dsh-plugin adds a Lynkr model provider to DSH settings.yaml. It points to a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint, keeps an existing provider entry, and prints manual setup guidance if configuration fails. It references LYNKR_API_KEY and defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8081/v1.
想让 DSH 通过我本机运行的 Lynkr 网关接入模型。
DSH 里怎么添加一个指向本地 OpenAI 兼容服务的模型提供方？
I want DSH to use my local Lynkr gateway as a model provider.
lynkr-dsh-plugin 的功能「注册本地提供方」：加载时将 Lynkr 地址和模型标识写入 settings.yaml；已有条目会保留，失败时提示手动配置。
lynkr-dsh-plugin 使用前须知：provider 配置引用 LYNKR_API_KEY 环境变量；是否需要有效值取决于本机 Lynkr 实例是否启用认证（src/index.ts:48-52,110-114）。

lynkr-dsh-plugin README · lynkr-dsh-plugin：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin that registers **[Lynkr](https://github.com/veerareddyvishal144/lynkr)** — a self-hosted, multi-provider LLM tier-routing gateway — as a custom OpenAI-compatible provider.

lynkr-dsh-plugin README · lynkr-dsh-plugin：Lynkr sits in front of coding agents and chat clients and routes each request to the cheapest model tier that can actually handle it (classifying difficulty per-request), across 15+ providers — Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex, OpenRouter, Moonshot, Baidu, Z.AI, Ollama, DeepSeek, and more.

lynkr-dsh-plugin README · Unofficial / community plugin：This is **not** affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. DeepSeek Harness's own repository does not accept external pull requests to its built-in provider catalog (see their `CONTRIBUTING.md`) — publishing a package tagged [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) is their documented path for community integrations instead, so that's what this is.

lynkr-dsh-plugin README · Install (once published)：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add lynkr-dsh-plugin
```

On next load, this adds to `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    lynkr:
      apiKeyEnv: LYNKR_API_KEY

lynkr-dsh-plugin README · Install (once published)：Then:
1. `export LYNKR_API_KEY=anything` (Lynkr doesn't enforce auth on local requests by default — set this to whatever your instance actually expects if you've locked it down).
2. Make sure Lynkr is running: `lynkr start` (see the [Lynkr repo](https://github.com/veerareddyvishal144/lynkr)).
3. Select the `lynkr` provider in `dsh`'s model picker. Whatever model you pick there is a label — Lynkr's own tier router decides the real backend server-side based on request complexity.
lynkr-dsh-plugin README · Install (once published)：It never overwrites an existing `lynkr` entry, and never touches any other provider's config.

lynkr-dsh-plugin README · Manual setup (no plugin required)：Skip the plugin entirely and just add the block above to `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` yourself. This is the fallback path the plugin itself prints if the automatic merge ever fails, and it's equally valid as your starting point.

lynkr-dsh-plugin README · Development：```bash
npm install
npm run build
```
